description: Fast Tier-0 SOAR phishing & attachment triage. Evaluates a document in milliseconds and returns verdict ('clean' | 'suspicious' | 'malicious'), recommended_action ('allow' | 'detonate_in_sandbox' | 'quarantine_and_detonate'), escalate_to_sandbox, matched CVEs, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and AI prompt-injection findings. Pass 'text_content', 'content_base64', or 'url' (https://).

api_key.description: Optional MalwareTracker API key (mt_live_...) if not authenticated via OAuth or headers.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded bytes (or data:...;base64, URI) of the attachment to triage.

text_content.description: Raw UTF-8 text/HTML body to triage if binary bytes are unavailable.

url.description: Public https:// URL of the attachment to triage.

name: quicksand_triage_document
title: SOAR Tier-0 Document Triage
